channel.title: Vintage Story Mod DB - Latest Updates
channel.description: Newest mod releases and updates from the Vintage Story Mod DB

item.title: Downed
item.description: Replaces the vanilla downed state with a survivable, invulnerable downed state. Quite bloody.

item.title: fStats
item.description: A stat library for use with fClasses and fSkills.

item.title: Directional Wind
item.description: Makes the wind change direction over time, with foliage and rain following it

item.title: Limestone And Bauxite Maps
item.description: Bring the treasure hunter a tin bronze tool and he’ll map the nearest limestone or bauxite for you

item.title: SheatheOrDrop
item.description: Makes it so weapons may only be carried in the active hotbar slot, the offhand, or a sheath.

item.title: Veneer
item.description: Adds veneers for cheaper chiseling details.

item.title: Horde Storms
item.description: Temporal storms become horde nights: drifters hunt you, breaking doors and walls to get in.

item.title: Clans And territory
item.description: Clans with land claims, unique map shields, markers, allies, enemies and PvP vault drops.

item.title: Guaranteed FZ Grape Cultivation
item.description: Tweaks the drop chance of higher tiers of grape cuttings from Floral Zones to 100%.

item.title: Meaf's Mixed Metals!
item.description: Ever been annoyed you can't combine multiple types of ingots in one stack? Now you can!

item.title: Wearable Pipes
item.description: Adds a pipe and pipe with eyepatch cosmetic.
